Purpose led · I make things better

I make complex operations easier to run.

I am Pupsi Phull, an operations and supply chain leader based in Burnham, Berkshire. For more than 20 years I have run operations where a missed delivery, a stock error or a stalled change programme has real consequences.

Where I have worked

From logistics to regulated MedTech.

My career has taken me through DX Group, CRYOPDP and DHL GlobalMatch, then to RS Group, where I led a £100m P&L and a 16-branch network of about 180 colleagues. As VAS and Technical Director, I held a separate £230m revenue scope. I now lead supply chain operations in regulated MedTech.

What I have learned

The dashboard is not the operation.

The number on the dashboard is rarely the problem. At RS Group, OTIF rose from 60% to 85% across the branch network in four months. The pattern repeated across roles: find the real cause, agree one version of the truth, then build routines that hold without me in the room.

How I work

Evidence, then the smallest useful step.

I separate what we know from what we assume. I recommend the first change worth making, not the biggest programme possible. Every change has an owner, a measure and a check at 30 and 90 days.

Why Phull?

Full insight. Real depth.

Phull is my family name. It sounds like “full”, which is the promise: full insight, not a partial view. In Punjabi, phull (ਫੁੱਲ) means flower, a fitting image for understanding that opens up layer by layer.

Qualifications

Executive, sustainability and delivery credentials.

Executive MBA, Cranfield (2022) · Postgraduate Certificate in Sustainability, Cranfield (2026) · BSc, De Montfort University · PRINCE2 Practitioner · Six Sigma

Outside work, I serve as a Scout District Trustee.
